title: Unemployment Benefit Claims — Claimant Payment Method Election
content:
When the claimant elects how benefits on an Unemployment Benefit Claims record are paid, the election records the new payment method and the payment method effective date, which falls the election lead time in business days (Monday through Friday excluding state holidays) after the day the election is recorded. Payments issued on or after that effective date use the elected method.

## Who makes the election

The claimant makes this election personally. The function is `elect_payment_method_0e517696`, a claimant-side tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `claim_id` | The claim reference number of the claimant's claim, read to the claimant by the agent from the claim lookup |
| `payment_method` | The method the claimant elects, one of the values below |
| `lead_business_days` | The election lead time: an integer number of business days counted from the day after the day of the election, as told to the claimant by the agent |

Values of `payment_method`:

- `direct_deposit_checking` — benefits go by direct deposit to a checking account in the claimant's name;
- `direct_deposit_savings` — benefits go by direct deposit to a savings account in the claimant's name;
- `debit_card` — benefits go to the state benefit debit card;
- `paper_check` — benefits are mailed as a paper check to the mailing address of record.

## Return

A successful run returns `claim_id`, `payment_method` (the elected method) and `payment_method_effective_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the first payment date that uses the elected method). Receiving `payment_method_effective_date` means the election is recorded. The effective date falls the given number of business days, Monday through Friday excluding Lakeland state holidays, after the day of the election.

### Hypothetical input and return

An election of `direct_deposit_savings` run on a Tuesday with a lead time of 3 business days and no state holiday in that week returns an effective date on the Friday of that week.
